Recovery result says check file data, candidate states separate Recuperable from Podría recuperarse, metadata change requests rescan, and same-volume recovery warns of overwriting deleted data. No actual recovery verified.
Hardlinks use both vínculos físicos and enlaces duros, while symbolic links and junctions retain separate labels. Terminology varies but does not collapse them into duplicate byte equality.
Sparsify is Convertir archivo a disperso and differs from compression. Glob versus regex and logical versus physical size remain explicit.

Target selection is translated Seleccionar Destino, potentially ambiguous between scan target and output destination; cloud warning explains potential download and option changes. These are wording observations without rendered UI reproduction.

Permanent deletion menu says no recovery while cleanup tooltip says permanently delete. These labels do not establish secure erasure. MSI es-ES/3082/1252 declarations require separate installer/runtime checks.
